updates.prompt: On an access point that supports centralized AAA for administrator login, which two protocols can provide device-administration AAA? (Choose two.)

updates.prompt: Which two statements describe EIGRP route selection and loop-free backup paths? (Choose two.)

options.label: A
options.text: The reported distance advertises only the bandwidth of the local link.

options.label: B
options.text: The router computes a total metric to the destination through each candidate neighbor.

options.label: C
options.text: The router must use the neighbor-reported distance alone as its own complete path metric.

options.label: D
options.text: A feasible successor is a backup path that meets the feasibility condition.

options.label: E
options.text: The reported distance is always the local exit-interface delay multiplied by 256.

updates.explanation: B、D。本地计算经各候选邻居到达目的地的复合度量；可行距离 FD 是 DUAL 用于可行性判断的距离，不能笼统称每条路径各有一个 FD。邻居报告距离 RD 严格小于 FD 时，该邻居路径满足可行性条件，可以成为可行后继。没有满足条件的备份也可能发生；切换并不保证零丢包。A/C/E 将 RD 与单链路带宽、路径完整度量或单个延迟混同。原 B/D 说法不精确，已修订。

corrections.reason: 逐项核对题干、选项、答案及解析；修正错误、歧义或绝对化表述。

updates.prompt: Two operational routers participate in the same HSRP group on one LAN and exchange hellos. Which two behaviors are expected? (Choose two.)
updates.explanation: A、E。两个正常交换 HSRP hello 的路由器在该组中协商 active 与 standby；主机可使用共享虚拟 IP 作为默认网关，active 响应并承担该虚拟网关的转发。故障检测和切换需要时间，分区或配置错误也可能导致异常。单组不自动在两个网关间负载均衡；多组可用于手工分担。HSRP 不负责同步完整设备配置，物理接口 IP 通常各不相同。

updates.prompt: Which two listed dynamic routing protocols are distance-vector protocols? (Choose two.)
updates.explanation: B、E。RIP 是距离矢量协议，EIGRP 通常归类为高级距离矢量协议，使用 DUAL 并发送触发式增量更新。OSPF 与 IS-IS 属链路状态协议；BGP 常称路径矢量协议。距离矢量不意味着所有协议都周期性发送完整路由表。

updates.prompt: Which two statements describe inter-autonomous-system routing in the Internet? (Choose two.)

options.label: A
options.text: Interior gateway protocols are required to exchange routes between every pair of autonomous systems.

options.label: B
options.text: Exterior routing can exchange reachability and select policy-based paths between autonomous systems.

options.label: C
options.text: BGP is the standard protocol used for Internet inter-AS routing.

options.label: D
options.text: The obsolete EGP protocol is required alongside BGP in every modern network.

options.label: E
options.text: EIGRP is the standard Internet-wide inter-AS routing protocol.

updates.explanation: B、C。BGP 是互联网跨自治系统交换可达性和按策略选路的标准协议；最佳路径由策略及协议属性决定，不一定是物理最短路径。旧 EGP 指特定历史协议，不是所有外部协议的同义词。A 错把 IGP 设为所有 AS 间路由交换的必需协议；BGP 也可用 iBGP 在 AS 内传播路由。D 的“每个网络必须”错误，EIGRP 通常是 IGP。原题 A 不完整，已明确范围并避免对所有设备支持情况作绝对断言。

corrections.reason: 逐项核对题干、选项、答案及解析；修正错误、歧义或绝对化表述。
